verdict.rationale: Restate's flow-control docs mention per-scope concurrency limits that are said to 'keep scheduling fair' and protect downstream services, but there is no evidence of an actual priority-assignment mechanism for runs or tenant-aware fair-share scheduling beyond simple concurrency caps. missing for 10: explicit priority levels per run/tenant, documented fair-share or weighted scheduling algorithm, and any independent confirmation that concurrency limits actually prevent one tenant's queue from starving another.
